metric_convention: Canonical ValidationEngine; PBIAS simulated minus observed; modified KGE CV ratio
limitations: One basin and fixed experimental management, not historical rotation reconstruction or spatial generalization.
Derived FSPM moisture assumes uniform available-water fraction across soil layers.
2010 plant morphology is a prespecified model-derived contract, not observed or a representative year demonstrated empirically.
External ET/PET products remain process diagnostics, not measured ET targets.
ML can correct outlet errors without validating physiology or preserving water balance.
One basin, 60 TRAIN months and 36 previously explored development validation months.
FSPM parameters and states are model-derived, not independent physiological observations.
A/B retain substantial bias; ML improvement does not validate physical processes or conserve water balance.
D versus C combines a changed physical baseline and extra model features; it does not isolate FSPM feature value on the same physical arm.
interpretation: Held-out monthly outlet-flow comparison under fixed experimental management and exploratory physical calibration. Does not validate FSPM physiology or water balance; D/C changes baseline and features.
